domains.name: Progressive Gathering
domains.promise: Members work three tiered gathering tracks — /hunt, /dig, and /mine — pulling weighted-random loot on an owner-tuned cooldown, where bare hands earn common finds and progressively better tools unlock rarer, higher-value drops that either land in the fake-economy inventory or sell straight into the play-money wallet, with tool durability consumed per use to keep extraction honest. Every reward is play-money only: gathered loot and its sale value never touch real commerce, gathered items carry no real-money value, and a commerce-purchased role or tool grants no gathering income beyond what the game rules give any member.

controls.description: Master switch for gathering (guild_config.economy_gathering_enabled); when off, /hunt, /dig, and /mine explain the feature is disabled and no loot tables are seeded.
Seconds a member must wait between gathers of the same source (guild_config.economy_gathering_cooldown_seconds), enforced atomically per member and source via a Valkey SET PX NX lock.

Weighted odds of a single loot-table row being picked (economy_loot_tables.weight); higher weight means the item is drawn more often, so owners tune drop rarity per entry on the dashboard gathering page.
Play-money coins credited per unit when a coin-yielding loot row is gathered (economy_loot_tables.sell_value); this is fake-economy currency only and never a real price.
Minimum tool tier that unlocks a loot row (economy_loot_tables.tool_tier): 0 is bare hands, 1 basic, 2 improved, 3 master; a member's best matching tool tier gates which drops they can roll.
Upper bound of the per-gather quantity range for a loot row (economy_loot_tables.max_qty), paired with min_qty to define how large a single find can be.

defaults.rationale: Gathering is a flagship game-economy loop; per the great-defaults owner theme it ships on so the feature works out of the box, and default loot tables seed automatically on first use.
A five-minute cooldown matches the shipped code default: frequent enough to feel rewarding, spaced enough to keep the play-money economy from inflating.
Mirrors the seeded common-tier weight so the baseline everyday find dominates the roll while rarer entries stay scarce.
Matches the seeded common drop's play-coin value: a small, steady early win that scales up with rarer, tool-gated finds.
Baseline drops start at tier 0 so a brand-new member with bare hands always gathers something; rarer rows raise the gate to reward tool investment.
A modest common-drop stack of up to three keeps early yields satisfying without runaway play-coin gains.

permissions.enforcement: Gathering slash commands respond for every member; each gather resolves the invoking member's own tools, cooldown, wallet, and inventory by their own guild and user id and never another member's.

permissions.actor: Dashboard user with owner or admin access to the guild
permissions.action: Edit gathering settings and loot-table entries on the dashboard economy gathering page
permissions.enforcement: The dashboard route requires the dashboard.manage_economy permission and Supabase RLS restricts guild_config and economy_loot_tables writes to authorized guild administrators.

permissions.action: Credit gathered coins or items into another member's wallet or inventory
permissions.enforcement: Every credit RPC (economy_add_balance, economy_upsert_inventory) is keyed to the invoking member's own guild and user id; no code path credits another member, and commerce-held roles earn no gathering income.

messages.trigger: A member gathers and receives loot or play coins
messages.audience: The invoking member and the channel

messages.trigger: A member gathers the same source again before its cooldown elapses
messages.surface: Ephemeral reply to the invoking member
messages.defaultTemplate: Easy there, {member-name} — you can go {source-verb} again in {cooldown-remaining}.

messages.trigger: A member gathers but their current tool tier unlocks no loot for that source
messages.surface: Ephemeral reply to the invoking member
messages.defaultTemplate: Bare hands only get you so far, {member-name} — upgrade your {tool-name} to unearth rarer finds.

messages.trigger: A member runs a gather command while gathering is disabled by configuration
messages.surface: Ephemeral reply to the invoking member
messages.defaultTemplate: Gathering isn't switched on here yet, {member-name} — ask an admin to enable it.

messages.trigger: The gathering backend is temporarily unreachable when a member runs a gather command
messages.surface: Ephemeral reply to the invoking member
messages.defaultTemplate: The trail's washed out for a moment, {member-name} — try gathering again shortly.

messages.trigger: A gather roll resolved but crediting the play coins or the inventory item failed
messages.surface: Ephemeral reply to the invoking member
messages.defaultTemplate: That find slipped through the net, {member-name} — nothing was credited, so try gathering again in a moment.

messages.trigger: A gather payout keeps failing to credit after the roll resolves
messages.defaultTemplate: Heads up: a gather payout of {reward} to {member-name} failed after the roll and needs a look; nothing was credited or double-credited and everything is logged.

values.description: The member has no gather in flight and is off cooldown; /hunt, /dig, and /mine are ready to run.
A gather roll is in flight: the cooldown lock is claimed, tool durability is being consumed, and the weighted loot roll is crediting atomically.
The member just gathered and is inside the cooldown window; further gathers of that source are refused until it elapses.
A gather roll failed to credit loot or coins; no reward was granted and the member can retry once the transient fault clears.
Gathering disabled by configuration; gather commands explain the feature is off and no loot tables are seeded or rolled.

transitions.trigger: A member runs /hunt, /dig, or /mine while gathering is enabled and they are off cooldown
transitions.expectedEffect: An atomic Valkey SET PX NX claims the cooldown exactly once and the tool-tier-filtered weighted loot roll begins.

transitions.trigger: The roll credits play coins via economy_add_balance or an item via economy_upsert_inventory
transitions.expectedEffect: Exactly one credit effect lands and exactly one economy_transactions row of type gather is recorded with the post-credit balance.

transitions.trigger: A durability, wallet, or inventory RPC fails during the roll
transitions.expectedEffect: The gather is cancelled fail-closed: no coins or items are credited, no gather transaction is written, and the member is told nothing was credited.

transitions.trigger: The Valkey cooldown key TTL expires
transitions.expectedEffect: The member becomes eligible to gather that source again with no residual state.

transitions.trigger: The transient fault clears and any claimed cooldown elapses
transitions.expectedEffect: The member can gather again and a fresh roll credits exactly once with no double effect from the failed attempt.

transitions.trigger: Owner turns economy_gathering_enabled off on the dashboard
transitions.expectedEffect: Gather commands reply with the disabled explanation; loot tables, wallets, and inventories are preserved untouched.
Gathering resumes; the first gather per source seeds default loot if none exists and then resolves normally.

failures.trigger: economy_decrement_durability returns non-true while consuming the member's tool
failures.expectedBehavior: Gathering is cancelled fail-closed so no loot or coins are granted and no gather transaction is written, preventing infinite free extraction; the member is told to try again.

failures.trigger: economy_add_balance returns an error after a coin-yielding gather roll
failures.expectedBehavior: No coins are credited and no economy_transactions row is written, the member sees the branded credit-failed notice, repeated failures raise exactly one owner alert, and a later retry credits exactly once with no double-credit.

failures.trigger: economy_upsert_inventory returns an error after an item-yielding gather roll
failures.expectedBehavior: No inventory row is created or incremented and no gather transaction is written, the member is told nothing was added, and a later retry adds exactly one stack with no phantom or duplicated inventory.

failures.trigger: Supabase is unreachable when a member runs a gather command
failures.expectedBehavior: The command fails safe with the branded gathering-unavailable message, no cooldown is claimed and no coins or items move, and the next gather after recovery resolves normally with exactly one effect.

evidence.observer: Discord observer client joined to the primary test guild
evidence.expectedObservation: Gathering behavior contracted here is directly observed working in the live test guild: /hunt, /dig, and /mine roll tool-tier-appropriate loot, coin drops credit the play-money wallet, item drops land in inventory, the cooldown blocks a too-soon repeat, and a better tool unlocks rarer finds.

evidence.observer: Supabase service-role SQL probe paired with anon and second-guild RLS probe clients
evidence.expectedObservation: The economy_loot_tables, economy_wallets, economy_transactions, economy_inventory, and guild_config rows enforce guild-scoped row-level security: the service role sees scenario rows while anon and cross-guild clients see none.

evidence.observer: Audit-log table reader using the service role
evidence.expectedObservation: Every state change in this domain lands exactly one append-only audit row with actor, guild, and correlation id; anonymization, never deletion, is the only mutation observed.

evidence.observer: Owner alert channel observer in the primary test guild
evidence.expectedObservation: This domain's failure branches raise exactly one owner alert carrying a human-readable reason and remediation hint; happy paths raise none.

evidence.observer: Embed and message snapshot inspector comparing captures against the configured brand kit
evidence.expectedObservation: Captured embeds and messages for this domain match the owner's white-label brand kit and configured voice preset, including the subtle powered-by-SomniBot attribution.

evidence.observer: Event re-delivery harness with a duplicate detector over gather credits, inventory grants, and transaction rows
evidence.expectedObservation: Replaying recorded gather triggers for this domain against the live stack leaves end state unchanged: no duplicate play-money credits, inventory grants, or gather transactions.

evidence.observer: Post-run resource sweeper diffing run-prefixed inventory before and after the suite
evidence.expectedObservation: After the suite a sweep of the test guilds and database finds no run-prefixed resources from this domain remaining anywhere.

Every member-facing gathering surface in this scenario shows the owner's configured brand name, colors, and voice preset with the subtle powered-by-SomniBot attribution and zero stock-bot wording.
